query.text: 请帮我照看家里的老人，如果发生摔倒等意外或危险请及时提醒并呼救。
query.text_en: Please help me watch the elderly person at home, and immediately alert and call for help if an accident or danger like a fall occurs.

annotation.text_zh: 老人摔倒后还没有起身，请尽快查看，并协助联系救援。
annotation.text_en: The older person has not got up after falling. Please check on them promptly and help contact emergency assistance.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
